About this program
Improve data engineering performance through informatics.
Exploring the 'fourth paradigm' of science and engineering through this interdisciplinary PhD in Informatics and Computing, you will prepare for advanced careers in your field. In this program, you will master various research and software-development methods through collaboration with on-campus organizations and research facilities—including the Centers for Bioengineering Innovation, Microbial Genetics and Genomics, and Ecosystem Science—to empower your professional goals as an expert in data analytics and technology.
